title: Θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U from θ ≥ 1 and ApproxTangentAE (statement (1.1))
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE. Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ ℕ, V a rectifiable n-varifold in E = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, U ⊆ E open, and suppose θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U (V.MultiplicityGE 1 U). Then for μ_V-a.e. x ∈ U the density Θ(x) = lim_{ρ↓0} μ_V(B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρⁿ) exists (V.HasDensityAt x (V.density x)) and Θ(x) ≥ 1.
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), 0 < n → IsOpen U → V.MultiplicityGE 1 U → ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ U → V.HasDensityAt x (V.density x) ∧ 1 ≤ V.density x
